  <script>
    let sessionId = 'lummet-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
    let isStreaming = false;
    let adminToken = sessionStorage.getItem('lummetAdminToken') || null;
    let conversations = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lummetConversations') || '[]');

    document.getElementById('input').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); }
    });
    document.getElementById('input').addEventListener('input', function() {
      this.style.height = 'auto';
      this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
    });
    renderChatList();

    function sendSuggestion(text) { document.getElementById('input').value = text; sendMessage(); }

    async function sendMessage() {
      const input = document.getElementById('input');
      const text = input.value.trim();
      if (!text || isStreaming) return;
      const welcome = document.getElementById('welcome');
      if (welcome) welcome.remove();
      addMessage(text, 'user');
      input.value = '';
      input.style.height = 'auto';
      input.disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
      isStreaming = true;
      showTyping();
      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/chat/stream', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: text, session_id: sessionId })
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Stream failed');
        const contentType = response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
        if (contentType.includes('text/event-stream')) {
          await handleStream(response);
        } else {
          const data = await response.json();
          hideTyping();
          addMessage(data.answer || 'Sorry, I could not generate a response.', 'ai');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        hideTyping();
        try {
          const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ message: text, session_id: sessionId })
          });
          const data = await response.json();
          addMessage(data.answer || 'Sorry, something went wrong.', 'ai');
        } catch (e) {
          addMessage('Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.', 'ai');
        }
      } finally {
        isStreaming = false;
        input.disabled = false;
        document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
        input.focus();
        saveConversation(text);
      }
    }

    async function handleStream(response) {
      hideTyping();
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'message';
      msg.innerHTML = '<div class="avatar avatar-ai">✦</div><div class="message-content"><div class="name">Lummet AI</div><div class="text" id="streamingText"></div></div>';
      messagesEl.appendChild(msg);
      const textEl = msg.querySelector('#streamingText');
      textEl.id = '';
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = '', fullText = '';
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const lines = buffer.split('\n');
        buffer = lines.pop();
        for (const line of lines) {
          if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
            try {
              const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
              if (data.type === 'delta') {
                fullText += data.content;
                textEl.innerHTML = renderMarkdown(fullText);
                scrollToBottom();
              } else if (data.type === 'done') {
                if (data.sessionId) sessionId = data.sessionId;
              } else if (data.type === 'error') {
                textEl.innerHTML = renderMarkdown(data.content || 'An error occurred.');
              }
            } catch {}
          }
        }
      }
      saveConversation('', fullText);
    }

    function addMessage(text, type) {
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'message';
      const avatarClass = type === 'ai' ? 'avatar-ai' : 'avatar-user';
      const name = type === 'ai' ? 'Lummet AI' : 'You';
      const icon = type === 'ai' ? '✦' : '👤';
      msg.innerHTML = `<div class="avatar ${avatarClass}">${icon}</div><div class="message-content"><div class="name">${name}</div><div class="text">${type === 'ai' ? renderMarkdown(text) : escapeHtml(text)}</div></div>`;
      messagesEl.appendChild(msg);
      scrollToBottom();
    }

    function showTyping() {
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'message';
      msg.id = 'typingIndicator';
      msg.innerHTML = '<div class="avatar avatar-ai">✦</div><div class="message-content"><div class="name">Lummet AI</div><div class="typing"><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div></div></div>';
      messagesEl.appendChild(msg);
      scrollToBottom();
    }

    function hideTyping() {
      const t = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
      if (t) t.remove();
    }

    function scrollToBottom() {
      const m = document.getElementById('messages');
      m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
    }

    function newChat() {
      sessionId = 'lummet-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      messagesEl.innerHTML = `
        <div class="welcome" id="welcome">
          <div class="welcome-icon">✦</div>
          <h2>Lummet AI</h2>
          <p>Your iGaming Intelligence Assistant by Level.casino. Ask me about casino reviews, bonuses, payment methods, licenses, and more.</p>
          <div class="suggestions">
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Show me the best casinos available in my country')"><h3>🎰 Best casinos in my country</h3><p>Find top-rated casinos available where you are</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('What casino reviews are available?')"><h3>⭐ Browse casino reviews</h3><p>See all reviews published on Level.casino</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Which casinos support crypto payments?')"><h3>₿ Crypto casinos</h3><p>Find casinos that accept Bitcoin and crypto</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Compare Stake and BC.Game')"><h3>⚖️ Compare casinos</h3><p>Compare features, bonuses, and ratings</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('What bonuses are available?')"><h3>🎁 Casino bonuses</h3><p>Find the best welcome offers and promotions</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Tell me about responsible gambling')"><h3>🛡️ Responsible gambling</h3><p>Learn about safe gambling practices</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('What is Level.casino?')"><h3>ℹ️ About Level.casino</h3><p>Learn what Level.casino is and how it works</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('What payment methods do casinos support?')"><h3>💳 Payment methods</h3><p>Discover deposit and withdrawal options</p></div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      document.getElementById('input').focus();
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) toggleSidebar(false);
    }

    function saveConversation(userMsg, aiMsg) {
      const title = userMsg || (conversations[0]?.title) || 'New Chat';
      const existing = conversations.find(c => c.sessionId === sessionId);
      if (existing) {
        existing.lastMessage = aiMsg || existing.lastMessage;
        existing.timestamp = Date.now();
      } else {
        conversations.unshift({ sessionId, title: title.substring(0, 40), lastMessage: aiMsg || '', timestamp: Date.now() });
      }
      conversations = conversations.slice(0, 20);
      localStorage.setItem('lummetConversations', JSON.stringify(conversations));
      renderChatList();
    }

    function renderChatList() {
      const list = document.getElementById('chatList');
      if (conversations.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:center;">No conversations yet</div>';
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = conversations.map(c => `<div class="chat-item" onclick="loadConversation('${c.sessionId}')">${escapeHtml(c.title)}</div>`).join('');
    }

    function loadConversation(sid) {
      sessionId = sid;
      newChat();
      showToast('Conversation loaded. Continue chatting.');
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) toggleSidebar(false);
    }

    function toggleSidebar(forceState) {
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      if (forceState === false) sidebar.classList.remove('open');
      else if (forceState === true) sidebar.classList.add('open');
      else sidebar.classList.toggle('open');
    }

    function openAdmin() {
      if (!adminToken) { document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.add('show'); return; }
      document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.add('open');
      loadAdminData();
    }

    function closeAdmin() { document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.remove('open'); }

    async function doLogin() {
      const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value;
      const password = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
      if (!email || !password) return;
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          adminToken = data.token;
          sessionStorage.setItem('lummetAdminToken', adminToken);
          document.getElementById('loginOverlay').classList.remove('show');
          document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.add('open');
          loadAdminData();
          showToast('Welcome back, admin!');
        } else {
          document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'block';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        document.getElementById('loginError').textContent = 'Login failed. Try again.';
        document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'block';
      }
    }

    function adminHeaders() {
      return { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + adminToken };
    }

    async function loadAdminData() { loadCasinos(); loadReviews(); loadNews(); loadPages(); }

    async function loadCasinos() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/casinos', { headers: adminHeaders() });
        const data = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('casinosTableBody');
        if (data.casinos && data.casinos.length > 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = data.casinos.map(c => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(c.name||'')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(c.slug||'')}</td><td>${c.rating||'0'}</td><td>${escapeHtml(c.bonus_title||'')}</td><td>${c.published?'✅':'❌'}</td><td>${c.featured?'⭐':''}</td><td><button class="cmd-btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="togglePublish('casinos','${c.slug}')">${c.published?'Unpublish':'Publish'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
        } else { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No casinos found</td></tr>'; }
      } catch (e) { console.error('Load casinos:', e); }
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
      const d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = text; return d.innerHTML;
    }

    function renderMarkdown(text) {
      if (!text) return '';
      let html = escapeHtml(text);
      html = html.replace(/```(\w*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g, (_,l,c) => `<pre><code>${c.trim()}</code></pre>`);
      html = html.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
      html = html.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
      html = html.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
      html = html.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
      html = html.replace(/(?<!["'>])(https?:\/\/[^\s<]+)/g, '<a href="$1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
      html = html.replace(/^[\s]*[-*]\s+(.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>');
      html = html.replace(/(<li>.*<\/li>\n?)+/g, m => `<ul>${m}</ul>`);
      html = html.replace(/^\d+\.\s+(.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>');
      html = html.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
      html = html.replace(/<br>(<(?:ul|pre|ol))/g, '$1');
      html = html.replace(/(<\/(?:ul|pre|ol)>)<br>/g, '$1');
      return html;
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    // ── State ──
    let sessionId = 'lummet-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
    let isStreaming = false;
    let adminToken = sessionStorage.getItem('lummetAdminToken') || null;
    let conversations = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lummetConversations') || '[]');

    // ── Init ──
    document.getElementById('input').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); }
    });
    document.getElementById('input').addEventListener('input', function() {
      this.style.height = 'auto';
      this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 200) + 'px';
    });
    renderChatList();

    // ── Chat ──
    function sendSuggestion(text) { document.getElementById('input').value = text; sendMessage(); }

    async function sendMessage() {
      const input = document.getElementById('input');
      const text = input.value.trim();
      if (!text || isStreaming) return;

      const welcome = document.getElementById('welcome');
      if (welcome) welcome.remove();

      addMessage(text, 'user');
      input.value = '';
      input.style.height = 'auto';
      input.disabled = true;
      document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = true;
      isStreaming = true;

      showTyping();

      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/chat/stream', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ message: text, session_id: sessionId })
        });

        if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Stream failed');

        const contentType = response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
        if (contentType.includes('text/event-stream')) {
          await handleStream(response);
        } else {
          const data = await response.json();
          hideTyping();
          addMessage(data.answer || 'Sorry, I could not generate a response.', 'ai');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Stream error:', error);
        hideTyping();
        try {
          const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({ message: text, session_id: sessionId })
          });
          const data = await response.json();
          addMessage(data.answer || 'Sorry, something went wrong.', 'ai');
        } catch (e) {
          addMessage('Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.', 'ai');
        }
      } finally {
        isStreaming = false;
        input.disabled = false;
        document.getElementById('sendBtn').disabled = false;
        input.focus();
        saveConversation(text);
      }
    }

    async function handleStream(response) {
      hideTyping();
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'message';
      msg.innerHTML = '<div class="avatar avatar-ai">✦</div><div class="message-content"><div class="name">Lummet AI</div><div class="text" id="streamingText"></div></div>';
      messagesEl.appendChild(msg);
      const textEl = msg.querySelector('#streamingText');
      textEl.id = '';

      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = '', fullText = '';

      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        const lines = buffer.split('\n');
        buffer = lines.pop();
        for (const line of lines) {
          if (line.startsWith('data: ')) {
            try {
              const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
              if (data.type === 'delta') {
                fullText += data.content;
                textEl.innerHTML = renderMarkdown(fullText);
                scrollToBottom();
              } else if (data.type === 'done') {
                if (data.sessionId) sessionId = data.sessionId;
              } else if (data.type === 'error') {
                textEl.innerHTML = renderMarkdown(data.content || 'An error occurred.');
              }
            } catch {}
          }
        }
      }
      saveConversation('', fullText);
    }

    function addMessage(text, type) {
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'message';
      const avatarClass = type === 'ai' ? 'avatar-ai' : 'avatar-user';
      const name = type === 'ai' ? 'Lummet AI' : 'You';
      const icon = type === 'ai' ? '✦' : '👤';
      msg.innerHTML = `<div class="avatar ${avatarClass}">${icon}</div><div class="message-content"><div class="name">${name}</div><div class="text">${type === 'ai' ? renderMarkdown(text) : escapeHtml(text)}</div></div>`;
      messagesEl.appendChild(msg);
      scrollToBottom();
    }

    function showTyping() {
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      const msg = document.createElement('div');
      msg.className = 'message';
      msg.id = 'typingIndicator';
      msg.innerHTML = '<div class="avatar avatar-ai">✦</div><div class="message-content"><div class="name">Lummet AI</div><div class="typing"><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div><div class="typing-dot"></div></div></div>';
      messagesEl.appendChild(msg);
      scrollToBottom();
    }

    function hideTyping() {
      const t = document.getElementById('typingIndicator');
      if (t) t.remove();
    }

    function scrollToBottom() {
      const m = document.getElementById('messages');
      m.scrollTop = m.scrollHeight;
    }

    function newChat() {
      sessionId = 'lummet-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10);
      const messagesEl = document.getElementById('messages');
      messagesEl.innerHTML = `
        <div class="welcome" id="welcome">
          <div class="welcome-icon">✦</div>
          <h2>Lummet AI</h2>
          <p>Your iGaming Intelligence Assistant by Level.casino. Ask me about casino reviews, bonuses, payment methods, licenses, and more.</p>
          <div class="suggestions">
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Show me the best casinos available in my country')"><h3>🎰 Best casinos in my country</h3><p>Find top-rated casinos available where you are</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('What casino reviews are available?')"><h3>⭐ Browse casino reviews</h3><p>See all reviews published on Level.casino</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Which casinos support crypto payments?')"><h3>₿ Crypto casinos</h3><p>Find casinos that accept Bitcoin and crypto</p></div>
            <div class="suggestion-card" onclick="sendSuggestion('Tell me about responsible gambling')"><h3>🛡️ Responsible gambling</h3><p>Learn about safe gambling practices</p></div>
          </div>
        </div>`;
      document.getElementById('input').focus();
    }

    // ── Conversation History ──
    function saveConversation(userMsg, aiMsg) {
      const title = userMsg || (conversations[0]?.title) || 'New Chat';
      const existing = conversations.find(c => c.sessionId === sessionId);
      if (existing) {
        existing.lastMessage = aiMsg || existing.lastMessage;
        existing.timestamp = Date.now();
      } else {
        conversations.unshift({ sessionId, title: title.substring(0, 40), lastMessage: aiMsg || '', timestamp: Date.now() });
      }
      conversations = conversations.slice(0, 20);
      localStorage.setItem('lummetConversations', JSON.stringify(conversations));
      renderChatList();
    }

    function renderChatList() {
      const list = document.getElementById('chatList');
      if (conversations.length === 0) {
        list.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:center;">No conversations yet</div>';
        return;
      }
      list.innerHTML = conversations.map(c => `<div class="chat-item" onclick="loadConversation('${c.sessionId}')">${escapeHtml(c.title)}</div>`).join('');
    }

    function loadConversation(sid) {
      sessionId = sid;
      newChat();
      // In a full implementation, you'd load the conversation from the server
      showToast('Conversation loaded. Continue chatting.');
    }

    // ── Sidebar ──
    function toggleSidebar() { document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('open'); }

    // ── Admin ──
    function openAdmin() {
      if (!adminToken) { document.getElementById('loginOverlay').style.display = 'flex'; return; }
      document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.add('open');
      loadAdminData();
    }

    function closeAdmin() { document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.remove('open'); }

    async function doLogin() {
      const email = document.getElementById('loginEmail').value;
      const password = document.getElementById('loginPassword').value;
      if (!email || !password) return;

      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/login', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.success) {
          adminToken = data.token;
          sessionStorage.setItem('lummetAdminToken', adminToken);
          document.getElementById('loginOverlay').style.display = 'none';
          document.getElementById('adminOverlay').classList.add('open');
          loadAdminData();
          showToast('Welcome back, admin!');
        } else {
          document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'block';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        document.getElementById('loginError').textContent = 'Login failed. Try again.';
        document.getElementById('loginError').style.display = 'block';
      }
    }

    function adminHeaders() {
      return { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + adminToken };
    }

    async function loadAdminData() {
      loadCasinos(); loadReviews(); loadNews(); loadPages();
    }

    async function loadCasinos() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/casinos', { headers: adminHeaders() });
        const data = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('casinosTableBody');
        if (data.casinos && data.casinos.length > 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = data.casinos.map(c => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(c.name||'')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(c.slug||'')}</td><td>${c.rating||'0'}</td><td>${escapeHtml(c.bonus_title||'')}</td><td>${c.published?'✅':'❌'}</td><td>${c.featured?'⭐':''}</td><td><button class="cmd-btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="togglePublish('casinos','${c.slug}')">${c.published?'Unpublish':'Publish'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
        } else { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="7" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No casinos found</td></tr>'; }
      } catch (e) { console.error('Load casinos:', e); }
    }

    async function loadReviews() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/reviews', { headers: adminHeaders() });
        const data = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('reviewsTableBody');
        if (data.reviews && data.reviews.length > 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = data.reviews.map(r => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(r.title||'')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(r.casino_slug||'')}</td><td>${r.rating||'0'}</td><td>${r.published?'✅':'❌'}</td><td><button class="cmd-btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="togglePublish('reviews','${r.slug}')">${r.published?'Unpublish':'Publish'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
        } else { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No reviews found</td></tr>'; }
      } catch (e) { console.error('Load reviews:', e); }
    }

    async function loadNews() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/news', { headers: adminHeaders() });
        const data = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('newsTableBody');
        if (data.news && data.news.length > 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = data.news.map(n => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(n.title||'')}</td><td>${n.published?'✅':'❌'}</td><td>${n.created_at||''}</td><td><button class="cmd-btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="togglePublish('news','${n.slug}')">${n.published?'Unpublish':'Publish'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
        } else { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="4" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No news found</td></tr>'; }
      } catch (e) { console.error('Load news:', e); }
    }

    async function loadPages() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/pages', { headers: adminHeaders() });
        const data = await res.json();
        const tbody = document.getElementById('pagesTableBody');
        if (data.pages && data.pages.length > 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = data.pages.map(p => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(p.title||'')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(p.slug||'')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(p.type||'')}</td><td>${p.published?'✅':'❌'}</td><td><button class="cmd-btn" style="padding:4px 10px;font-size:12px;" onclick="togglePublish('pages','${p.slug}')">${p.published?'Unpublish':'Publish'}</button></td></tr>`).join('');
        } else { tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="5" style="color:var(--text-muted);">No pages found</td></tr>'; }
      } catch (e) { console.error('Load pages:', e); }
    }

    async function togglePublish(table, slug) {
      try {
        await fetch('/api/admin/toggle-publish', {
          method: 'POST', headers: adminHeaders(),
          body: JSON.stringify({ table, slug })
        });
        showToast('Updated successfully');
        loadAdminData();
      } catch (e) { showToast('Update failed'); }
    }

    function switchAdminSection(section) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.admin-nav-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelectorAll('.admin-section').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
      document.querySelector(`[data-section="${section}"]`).classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('section-' + section).classList.add('active');
    }

    // ── AI Commands ──
    async function executeCommand() {
      const cmd = document.getElementById('cmdInput').value.trim();
      if (!cmd) return;
      const output = document.getElementById('cmdOutput');
      output.textContent = 'Executing...';
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/ai-command', {
          method: 'POST', headers: adminHeaders(),
          body: JSON.stringify({ command: cmd })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        output.textContent = data.result || data.error || 'Done.';
        loadAdminData();
      } catch (e) { output.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message; }
    }

    async function executeCasinoCommand() {

    async function generateReview() {
      const name = document.getElementById('reviewCasinoName').value.trim();
      const country = document.getElementById('reviewCountry').value.trim() || 'RW';
      if (!name) return;
      const output = document.getElementById('reviewOutput');
      output.textContent = 'Generating review...';
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/admin/generate-review', {
          method: 'POST', headers: adminHeaders(),
          body: JSON.stringify({ casinoName: name, countryCode: country })
        });
        const data = await res.json();
        output.textContent = data.review || data.error || 'Generation failed.';
      } catch (e) { output.textContent = 'Error: ' + e.message; }
    }

    // ── Utils ──
    function showToast(msg) {
      const t = document.getElementById('toast');
      t.textContent = msg;
      t.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3000);
    }

    function escapeHtml(text) {
      const d = document.createElement('div'); d.textContent = text; return d.innerHTML;
    }

    function renderMarkdown(text) {
      if (!text) return '';
      let html = escapeHtml(text);
      html = html.replace(/```(\w*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g, (_,l,c) => `<pre><code>${c.trim()}</code></pre>`);
      html = html.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');
      html = html.replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
      html = html.replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');
      html = html.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
      html = html.replace(/(?<!["'>])(https?:\/\/[^\s<]+)/g, '<a href="$1" target="_blank" rel="noopener">$1</a>');
      html = html.replace(/^[\s]*[-*]\s+(.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>');
      html = html.replace(/(<li>.*<\/li>\n?)+/g, m => `<ul>${m}</ul>`);
      html = html.replace(/^\d+\.\s+(.+)$/gm, '<li>$1</li>');
      html = html.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
      html = html.replace(/<br>(<(?:ul|pre|ol))/g, '$1');
      html = html.replace(/(<\/(?:ul|pre|ol)>)<br>/g, '$1');
      return html;
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>
